# primitives
Pure domain building blocks. Import by subpath only (no root barrel). Need X -> use Y (subpath).
Skill: skills/primitives/SKILL.md

Money
/money: add, sum, compare Money (addMoney, fromMajor, sumMoney)
/currency: FX, codes (convertWithSnapshot, minorUnitFactor)
/split-allocation: exact splits (allocate, allocateDiscount)
/unit-cost-rate: fractional cost (unitCostRateFromTotal, extendedAmount)
/price-basis: price by weight or time (resolvePriceBasisTotal)
/usage-pricing: rate cards (priceUsage)
/monetization: sale kinds (unitPriceOf, monetizationKindOf)
/proration: period shares (periodProgress, splitByPeriodFraction)
/payment-gateway, /payment-method-kind, /payment-allocation-status, /bank-transaction: payment and bank shapes
/payment-events: payment payloads (isPaymentEvent, isFundsReceived)

Time
/timezone: day in a zone, shifts (civilDateOf, wallWindowAt)
/period: month, quarter, fiscal ranges (resolveMonth, resolvePeriod)
/calendar: fixed-offset day helpers (startOfDay, addMonths)
/calendar-facts: holiday tables (defineDateEdition, lookupDateFact)
/cadence: recurrence (nextOccurrence)
/sla, /sla-policy: targets (breachedAt, evaluateSLAStatus)
/deadline: promise timeout (withDeadline)
/concurrency: batches (mapBounded)
/shelf-life: expiry dates (deriveShelfLifeDates)
/suspension: pause rules (evaluateSuspension)

Events
/events: envelope (createEvent, createChildEvent)
/event-infra: dev bus (createInProcessBus)
/memory-outbox: test outbox (MemoryOutboxStore)
/outbox: OutboxStore contract
/durable-events: durable emit (durableEventMeta, dispatchDomainEvent)

Workflow
/state-machine: lifecycle (defineStateMachine, assertAndClaim)
/state-diagram: mermaid (toMermaid)
/status-history: audit trail (appendStatus, timeInStatus)
/approval: maker-checker (createChain, applyDecision)
/idempotency: retries (decideClaim, completeClaim)
/hold: blocks (addHold, isOnHold)
/condition: stored rules (evaluate)

People
/person, /person-parse: names (formatDisplayName, nameFromString)
/phone: E.164 (parsePhone)
/otp: codes (createOtpChallenge, verifyOtpChallenge)
/identity-verification: KYC (isVerified)
/subject: polymorphic ref (makeSubjectRef)
/legal-form: LEGAL_FORMS
/address: geo, formats (distanceMeters, validateAddress)
/identifier: pasted IDs (cleanIdentifier)

Stock
/quantity: decimal grid (addQuantity, snapQuantity)
/stock-level: sellable, isOversold
/item-identity: stockKeyOf, skuDisplay
/item-stock: itemStockOf
/item-facts: resolveStockFacts
/line-settlement: planSettlement
/testing/stock-key-seam: assertStockKeySeam

Base
/result: ok, err
/brand: type helpers
/reference: idToString, ExternalRef
/context: OperationContext
/mixin: withMixin, getMixin
/environment: readEnv, isProductionEnv
/fault-attribution: attributeFault
/signed-token: signToken, verifyToken
/canonical: canonicalDigest
/csv: escapeCsvCell, csvRecord, csvLines (lazy whole-table CSV)
/retention: createPurgeEvidence

Not here: pagination, tenant, errors (@classytic/repo-core).
